hints.tr: Önce ay ve kategoriye göre ciro: üç tablo (`orders`, `order_items`, `products`), `DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(...), MONTH(...), 1)` ile ay başı, `GROUP BY` ay ve kategori. Bunu bir `WITH` ile adlandır.
hints.en: First the revenue by month and category: three tables (`orders`, `order_items`, `products`), the month start with `DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(...), MONTH(...), 1)`, `GROUP BY` month and category. Name it with a `WITH`.

hints.tr: Pay, ayın toplamına göre: `100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month)`. `PARTITION BY` olmazsa dört ayın toplamına bölersin.
hints.en: The share is against the month's total: `100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month)`. Without `PARTITION BY` you would divide by the total of all four months.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date), 1) AS month,
           p.category_code,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date), 1),
             p.category_code
)
SELECT month, category_code, revenue,
       CAST(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month)
            AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS share
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month, revenue DESC;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date), 1) AS month,
           p.category_code,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date), 1),
             p.category_code
)
SELECT month, category_code, revenue,
       CAST(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month)
            AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS share
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month, revenue DESC;
```

hint.tr: Ayın toplamını her satıra bir pencere yazıyor: `SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month)`.
hint.en: A window writes the month's total on every row: `SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month)`.
